revenue.source: ESEF ifrs-full:Revenue; reports 549300TTCXZOGZM2EY83-2025-01-31-ESEF-ES-0 (FY2023) and ...-2026-01-31-ESEF-ES-0 (FY2024, FY2025); EUR millions

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 3.2% and FY2024 7.5% (filed revenue); fade from ~5% to 3.5% toward terminal growth as store-space growth is modest and online matures.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 20.06% (7,997/39,864), FY2024 19.6%, FY2023 18.9%; slight uplift held flat at 20.5%.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 implied rate ~22.4% (key_metrics effective_tax_rate_proxy, ESEF); rounded to 22%.

da_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 D&A 3,270 / revenue 39,864 = 8.2% (ESEF); held flat. Includes right-of-use depreciation.

capex_pct_revenue.source: FY2025 capex 2,193 / revenue 39,864 = 5.5% (ESEF); held at 5.5%. Lease payments are not in capex, so FCF is somewhat overstated.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 3.266% (ECB 10Y AAA par yield, 2026-11-05) + beta 1.06 (Damodaran Europe Retail (Special Lines) cash-corrected unlevered beta 1.060, relevered at Inditex D/E ~0 since debt is 2m EUR) x ERP 5.78% (Damodaran Spain, 2026-02-16) = 9.4%. Debt weight ~0 so WACC = cost of equity.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run euro-area nominal growth/inflation ~2%, below the 3.27% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: ESEF derived net_debt = total debt 2 (current borrowings) - cash 5,276 - short-term deposits 5,684; EUR millions; report 549300TTCXZOGZM2EY83-2026-01-31-ESEF-ES-0. Lease liabilities excluded.
